parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the AttributeError issue by ensuring the renderer is not None. However, it introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the behavior of the __call__ method.

issues.description: The patch introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the behavior of the __call__ method, which may have unintended side effects.
